test_objective: Check that you cannot update entity attributes with invalid/missing id or invalid request body

test_cases.name: 011_02_01 Update an attribute if the Entity Id is not present
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot update entity attributes with invalid/missing id or invalid request body
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-speed-two-datasetid-01-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}

test_cases.name: 011_02_02 Update an attribute if the Entity Id is not a valid URI
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot update entity attributes with invalid/missing id or invalid request body
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to 'thisisaninvaliduri' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'vehicle-speed-two-datasetid-01-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
